q1_what_did_you_play: I played Ka-pow! first, spending the 1 Spark for 7 damage and Pyro, then played both Kaboom! cards for 7 damage and Pyro each. This dealt 21 total damage to Sludge Spinner, used 2 Energy, and left 1 Energy unused. I did not play Duck and Cover or Spark Knight's Oath.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Ka-pow!, one Kaboom!, and Duck and Cover instead. That line would deal 14 damage and gain 5 Block, trading 7 damage for 5 Block while still using the free Spark attack.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the 5 Block from Duck and Cover. Against the telegraphed 8 damage attack, that means taking 8 damage instead of 3, ending the turn at 34 HP rather than 39 HP. It also left 1 Energy unused, though no remaining card could be played usefully with it.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Sludge Spinner had telegraphed a much larger attack, especially one that would be lethal without Block, I would have prioritized Duck and Cover. With the current 8 damage intent, the player can safely take the hit, so the extra damage is the better trade.
